long_description:
# v0.6.17

## Changes

### Features
- Added bell notification system in Header for app and build updates
- Added automatic catalog refresh every 60 minutes on startup
- Added action buttons in bell: "Install & Restart" for app updates, "View in Catalog" for build updates

### UI / UX Improvements
- Moved update notifications from Dashboard badge to Header bell dropdown
- Removed green "Latest Build" badge from Dashboard card for cleaner UI
- Styled notification buttons with theme-consistent Button components

### Documentation
- Enhanced README with terminal management information
